# Rework round 8 claims (personal_loan_servicing)

PLS-R7-1: closed — the courtesy scope is now exactly the computed object: the latest late fee charged on the loan (first recorded on ties), while no fee payment has posted against it. The overwrite's replaced_by and its rule copy name every other fee as under the base clause, restated: an earlier late fee, a returned-payment fee and a latest late fee a fee payment has already reached. The policy baseline sentence, the c_unpaid quote and the task-1 amount tracing name the same object.
PLS-R7-2(a): closed — the boundary is stated plainly as a business boundary in the rule. A fee payment reaches a late fee only through the normal payment allocation, after the loan's accrued interest and every older unpaid fee are paid, so a late fee a payment has reached is one the borrower is already paying down. That fee stays under the standard courtesy clause of loan_evt_fee_waiver, which waives the whole part still unpaid, so a fee the borrower has begun paying is cleared rather than left with a small remainder. The boundary sentence sits after the policy's baseline span, and every order-of-steps sentence is intact.
PLS-R7-2(b): closed — the returned-fee overwrite is now a self-naming scope: the fee owed on the latest returned payment (first recorded on ties), and only that fee, gets the bank-event form and the returned-fee shares. Every other returned-payment fee, one owed on an earlier fee-bearing return included, stays under the base clause, restated verbatim in replaced_by and in the rule. The rule states the business reason: the reductions weigh the bounce being handled now, and an earlier bounce left uncharged is a catch-up charge at the schedule amount.
PLS-R7-2(c): closed — the payoff quote policy now issues the refinance-purpose quote only for a loan on which no additional-principal payment other than the latest one is still on hold under the hold rule, so holding the latest payment covers every payment still on hold. Every other refinance-purpose quote is an ordinary payoff quote under loan_evt_payoff_quote. All three quote overwrites name that scope ("a refinance-purpose quote this policy issues"), and each says the ordinary base content governs every other quote. The hold sentence no longer says "looking only at".
PLS-R7-2(d): closed — the day-rate split now computes the rate in force each day from both the latest enrollment and the latest cancellation. Cancellation only, enrollment only, cancellation then re-enrollment, and enrollment then cancellation after the paid-through date each have their own tier, in rule, ladder and compute, which agrees with base loan_evt_autopay's rate in force that day. The quote scope also requires at most one enrollment and at most one cancellation after the paid-through date, the case those two records fully describe; any other refinance-purpose quote is an ordinary payoff quote.
XF#14 (both task files): closed — the task-0 day-rate tier label was regenerated from the new ladder, and the task-0 day-rate trace, necessity text and hold trace now state the scope facts. The task-1 courtesy amount tracing names the latest late fee. A mechanical sweep (tier labels, trace labels, all-baseline results, edge copies, dossier quotes, retired terms) is clean.
R4-O1, R3-O1, R2-O3, R2-O4: carried — unchanged.
